description: Register a SigmaResource wrapping Sigma Computing's REST API (OAuth2 client_credentials grant) for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Sigma API Client ID

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Sigma API Client Secret

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Sigma REST API base URL for your org's cloud/region (AWS-US-West default; AWS-US-East/CA/EU/UK/AU and Azure/GCP each have a distinct host).

name: Sigma Resource
